intro: Welcome to the squad, rookie! I'm Captain Rae.
You're a road warden now. Your job: master Virginia roads.
First, we learn the controls and how the big test works.
Hands on the wheel. Eyes up. Let's roll!
districts.bossIntro: The Gatekeeper guards the yard. Show it you know the basics, rookie!
districts.outro: Gate's open! You crushed the basics. The real roads are calling.

intro: Signs talk before you can even read them.
Here you learn what each shape and color means.
Spot the shape. Spot the color. Know the sign.
districts.bossIntro: The Shape Shifter keeps changing form. Read its shape and color to win!
districts.outro: Shape Shifter down! Your eyes are sharp now, warden.

intro: This strip is all about rule signs.
These signs tell you the law. You must obey them.
Stop, yield, speed, no turns. Let's lock them in.
districts.bossIntro: The Enforcer only respects drivers who follow the rules. Prove it!
districts.outro: The Enforcer salutes you! You know the law of the road.

intro: Welcome to Warning Hills. Lots of yellow out here.
Warning signs tell you what is coming up ahead.
We also cover railroad crossings. Stay sharp near the tracks!
districts.bossIntro: The Hazard King throws danger at every turn. Read the warnings, warden!
districts.outro: Hazard King dethroned! Nothing ahead can surprise you now.

intro: Orange means work zone. Workers are out here!
You'll learn flaggers, work zone signs, and guide signs.
Guide signs help you find your way and find services.
districts.bossIntro: The Foreman runs this zone. Slow down, stay alert, and beat the crew!
districts.outro: Foreman cleared! You keep workers safe and always find your way.

intro: Signal Junction! Lights, arrows, and lines everywhere.
Learn traffic lights, lane signals, and road paint.
Painted curbs have colors too. Every mark means something.
districts.bossIntro: The Signal Master flashes every light at once. Read them all, warden!
districts.outro: Signal Master beaten! Red, yellow, green, you own them all.

intro: Big question here: who goes first?
You'll learn stopping, yielding, and roundabouts.
Plus school buses and emergency vehicles. Safety first, always.
districts.bossIntro: The Crossroads Judge decides who goes first. Make every call right!
districts.outro: Court adjourned! You know who goes first, every time.

intro: Welcome to the highway, warden. Things move fast here.
Learn speed limits and how far it takes to stop.
Keep space around your car. Scan the road ahead.
districts.bossIntro: The Speed Demon wants you rushing. Keep your cool and your space!
districts.outro: Speed Demon outsmarted! Smart speed beats fast speed.

intro: Lane & Pass Parkway. Time for smooth moves.
Changing lanes, passing, turning, and using your signals.
Check blind spots. Learn backing up and parking too.
districts.bossIntro: The Lane Bandit cuts in everywhere. Signal, check, and move with care!
districts.outro: Lane Bandit caught! Your moves are clean and safe.

intro: The road is not just for cars, warden.
Watch for people walking, bikes, and motorcycles.
Big trucks and light rail share the road too.
districts.bossIntro: The Big Rig rolls in heavy. Give it room and share the road!
districts.outro: Big Rig handled! You look out for everyone on the road.

intro: Storm Pass. Rain, fog, snow, and dark nights ahead.
Learn when to use headlights and how to drive in bad weather.
Also deer, crashes, and what to do if police stop you.
districts.bossIntro: The Storm is here. Slow down, see clearly, and ride it out!
districts.outro: The Storm has passed! You stay calm in any weather.

intro: Zero Tolerance zone. This one is serious, warden.
Learn about angry, distracted, sleepy, and drunk driving.
Phones down. Eyes up. Clear head. Every time.
districts.bossIntro: The Distraction wants your eyes off the road. Stay focused and win!
districts.outro: Distraction defeated! Your focus is your superpower.

intro: Buckle Bay! Time to talk safety gear.
Learn seat belts, air bags, and child safety seats.
Click it before you go. Let's do this.
districts.bossIntro: The Crash Test checks if everyone is buckled right. Pass it, warden!
districts.outro: Crash Test passed! Everyone rides safe with you.

intro: Court Street. Here we learn what happens when drivers break rules.
Suspensions, revocations, and demerit points.
Plus insurance rules. Know them so you never face them.
districts.bossIntro: The Judge knows every penalty. Answer clearly and keep your record clean!
districts.outro: Case closed! You know the rules and the price of breaking them.

intro: DMV Plaza. Last stop before the big day!
Learn testing rules, vision checks, and learner's permits.
Plus license types and other DMV rules.
districts.bossIntro: The Clerk checks every detail. Show you know the DMV rules!
districts.outro: The Clerk stamps your file. Exam Day is next, warden!

intro: This is it, warden. Exam Day.
First come the sign questions. Then the general questions.
No rush. Read each word. You trained for this.
districts.bossIntro: The DMV Exam awaits. Breathe, read every word, and show what you know.
districts.outro: You did it, road warden! Captain Rae is so proud of you!

missLines: Shake it off. Watch the replay.
No sweat. Every miss teaches you.
Close one. You'll get it next time.
Good try. Learn it, then crush it.
That's okay. Read the tip and go.
Even pros miss. Stay with me.
Eyes up. Next one is yours.
Not yet. That's how learning works.
Slow down a bit. Read every word.
Mistakes now mean wins on test day.
Shake it off, warden. Next gate!
Every miss makes your brain stronger.
rankUpLines: Rank up! Look at you go!
New rank, warden! You earned it.
Promotion time! The squad salutes you.
Level up! Your skills are growing.
Moving up the ranks. Nice work!
You just leveled up. Keep climbing!
Higher rank, bigger roads. Let's go!
Rank up! Hard work pays off.
Another rank down. Exam Day is closer.
Rookie no more. You're the real deal.
examDayPepTalk: The real DMV is quiet. That's okay. Take a slow breath.
Read every word of the question. Then read every answer.
No need to rush. Take your time on each one.
If one feels tricky, think of the road. You've seen it before.
You trained for this, warden. Trust what you know.
